notes.title: CHP update
notes.content:
New update:
-new HUD
-new damage screen effect
-inputs (quick look back, radar target select, zoom,..)
-9 planes, 6 maps, 10 players, 2 squads (deathmatch)
-singleplayer hornets mod (put your name in the top 50 on the leaderboard)
-and more,....

working on: 
-UI and HUD
-settings (audio, video, controller,..)
-rank and reward system (unlock stuff and getting rank based on MP game)
-planes models textures
-in-game customization
